evidence: The DRIFTS measurements were used to study the species formed on the alumina after chemisorption of the cobalt acetylacetonate precursors. Nitrogen physisorption, hydrogen and CO chemisorption and oxygen titration measurements were done with a Coulter OMNISORP 100CX. The degree of reduction was measured by O2-titration. Temperature programmed reduction (TPR) measurements were performed. CO chemisorption capacity was measured. The cobalt concentration was measured with atomic absorption spectrometry (AAS), inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS), or instrumental neutron activation analysis (INAA).
